title: Sleep Talk
author: Syeda Nafisa Tarannum
imageAlt: Cover image for Sleep Talk

runs.text: Sleep Talk

There are not many things that I miss from my early twenties, mainly because I remember being broke all the time and my parents treating me like a teenager, irregardless of the number of candles they had placed on my birthday cakes. However, if I could bring a few things back, first would definitely be my metabolism, closely followed by my waistline. Of all the things our thirty-something minds reminisce about the less complicated adult years - not having to chalk out meals every day, having friends available for impromptu plans, not having to deal with the house help, no back aches, no calcium deficiencies, the one that I most frequently find myself thinking about in recent years are- the nights. The limitless nights where my brain believed it had the capacity to engulf the entire syllabus for an exam scheduled for the next morning, nights where the hours expanded conveniently to binge watch a tv series, nights which witnessed the eyelids fighting battles to stay elevated while the eyeballs scampered across the pages of thriller novels. Despite juggling through classes, assignments and tuitions all day, there would still be abundance of stored energy reserved for the inky sacred hours. Energy to be deposited at whim - to slide from one chat conversation to the next on MSN (no Gen Z, it is not THAT long ago), to join aimless yet exhilarating group calls with friends, to weep through some somber ones for life suddenly felt unfair, and the most precious- to dive into hours of romantic phone calls where promises and dreams were exchanged.

Do I want any of it back? No, not really. New priorities, deepened patience, groomed taste, have all joined forces to incorporate the developed versions of these options into a more practical lifestyle. As dull and unoriginal of a pick it may be, practical is exactly the word, just like mature, reliable, responsible and all other adjectives that have shown up because the shift to the new advanced age bracket requires them to. Had this evolved adult that I am claiming myself to be, got a chance to meet my former self now, I would really like to ask why I did not use the nights to do what it was originally meant for. Why didn't I sleep? Is it because sleep then seemed like a mere waste of invaluable time? Or maybe the ability to nap as I pleased throughout the day made up for this indiscretion. Or the superpower of functioning effortlessly with barely any rest, thanks to all the leftover teenage energy still lingering in the body, enough to not take sleep seriously. Oh but, sleep I did, I remember waking up on days to find lunch being served, or skipping dinner and falling asleep because I just had to or even better, wanted to. What now baffles me is why I had then willingly given up the opportunity to sleep at will.

After going through two pregnancies in a span of three years, childbirths and taking care of two human beings always demanding attention, I have absolutely no memory of how it feels to sleep five to six hours at a stretch. Hence, current circumstances have induced this extreme annoyance towards my younger self for not utilising night-time right.
However.

There are hours when both children are asleep, and my body finally lets go. With one grabbing my arm, the other snuggled on my chest, I slowly readjust the pillows and the blankets. I gently position the children where they are meant to be, drag my tired self and lay my back on the mattress. My body moans in joy, eyelids finally sigh in relief, ready to bid adieu and drop curtains for the night- I let them believe we are there, a touch away from sweet escape, only to shamelessly betray them. I choose to explore Facebook posts and Instagram reels, check unread messages, look up scandalous events on YouTube, even seek verifications in Wikipedia that just cannot wait the night, over the needs of my weary body. "Just a couple of minutes it'll take", I promise myself. Why? Because- finally, finally I can watch or read or simply look at something with full concentration. Not while holding a restless baby, not with a toddler wailing because the toy car went forward not backwards, not while gulping down a cold lunch, not while being constantly nudged and stroked by tiny hands and feet. So yes, I fight sleep a little longer for such trivial indulgences, for a few moments of conscious peace, only to be jerked back to exhausting reality by a whimpering baby who needs to be fed and a mumbling toddler who needs his blanket to be rotated. The next morning, my brain to my body is like my husband to me after an impromptu boys' night out on a weekend. Apologies and regrets- waiting to be repeated all over again.

Wait, then what changed? Why am I criticising my actions dating years back? Here is what it really is. It is not the sleep I miss from the glorious youth of mine, it is the chance to choose. The reasons behind the choices. The scope to decide whether to use the nights for innumerable wonder sprees or surrender to sweet sweet slumber. Because one thing that I absolutely do not have now is the liberty to simply follow a wish of my own. My children decide when and how long I get to sleep, whether or not I deserve to rest. Resting now is luxury, sleep is unattainable, relaxation is yearned for.

I know this will pass, I'll be looking back at these nights where two people depended on me exclusively for comfort. I may be waking up every morning still exhausted, but I am greeted good morning with beautiful toothless grins, warm hugs and gentle kisses. Sooner than I would like, I'll have long stretches of nights completely to myself again, where no one will question or object to my choices, I will be free to lay awake and welcome dawn or cocoon myself in a blanket and dose off without a second thought. But, there won't be a crib parallel to my bed or a tiny pillow beside mine. I'll be left alone, but my heart will be lonely. So for now, this is alright. This utterly sleep deprived mother will enjoy the most precious company in the world, till time permits.
Nafisa Tarannum

title: Bombay Toasts And Signal Jammers
author: Nafiz-Bin-Hafiz
imageAlt: Cover image for Bombay Toasts And Signal Jammers

runs.text: On November 4
th
, 2021, my younger brother told my mom that he’s having a sudden
craving for Bombay toasts. For those who don’t know, it means sliced bread fried in
battered eggs and oil.
I overheard their conversation and thought I’ll buy some eggs and bread when I go out
in the evening so that my family can have some Bombay toasts the next morning.
Maybe I wouldn’t be there with them, maybe my family wouldn’t be in the mental state to
eat. But I thought it’d be a nice thing to do anyway.
When I was outside, I texted a friend of mine to grab a smoke for 5 minutes. It was the
same friend with whom I had my very first cigarette 5 years earlier. It’s poetic that my
last cigarette was going to be with him too, although my friend standing a few feet away
from me didn’t know that I was planning to kill myself that night.
At around 4-5 AM of November 5
th
, I quietly went to the rooftop with a pair of sharp
scissors and my suicide note in hand. The goal of the scissors was to slice my throat
just before jumping off from the rooftop as an extra layer of guarantee to my death. A 50
foot drop to the solid pavement should have been already enough to kill me anyway, but
I wanted to sprinkle in some additional blood loss in there . Because…..why not?
My handwritten suicide note said something along the lines of –
“ excuse the mess.
I , Nafiz Bin Hafiz, age 23, in full consciousness, am confirming that no one other than
myself is responsible for my death, and that my cause of death is hornyness.
I know dying from hornyness in a world where people are dying from heart disease,
cancer, diabetes, starvation, lack of clean water, war crimes etc is a wee bit outrageous.
But it is what it is.
Some might suggest ‘ if you’re not having sex but you would like to, then why not just
pay a prostitute?’
While I’m thankful for their input and have no personal hatred or judgement towards
prostitution, I would have to disagree to such suggestions . Because these people are
missing the whole point.
Because sex is not about sex.
It’s about what the sex means. It’s about the implication that sex carries behind its back.
When a woman has sex with me, she’s not just simply having sex with me. She’s doing
a lot more than just that. She’s making a conscious decision that her urge to have sex
with me is stronger than her urge to conform to other things like moral, social,
evolutionary and religious values. She’s making a comparison between me and
something else, and then declaring me as the winner. That win means something.
She’s concluding that I’m not a loser but rather a lovable person overall , someone
who’s worthy of what he’s about to have, someone who’s worth the sacrifice.
Being that someone means something.
Not everyone will deem me worthy of being that someone , of course. That is normal .
But if not a single person ever has deemed me worthy of being that someone, then that
could indicate something is terribly wrong with me.
If anyone just pays a few bucks to have sex, then he’s certainly having sex . But he’s
not getting everything else I just mentioned. It has become a much more simplified
transaction that says nothing about the likability and personal worth of that person. It is
still sex, but now without the underlying meaning.
So you could say I’m not dying from hornyness, but rather dying from the crushing
weight of being a possibly unworthy unlovable waste of oxygen.
Once again, excuse the mess.”
I remember standing on the railing that morning, looking straight down towards the
cement pavement 50 feet below with the large pair of scissors fully opened up to be
used like a knife . The light breeze brushing against my body was probably trying its
best to push me down. The ground below looked seductively comfortable, deathly
magnetic, as if its trying its best to pull me down. Despite the best efforts of everything I
didn’t really jump off that day. Because someone stopped me. I’m not talking about God,
but rather a person who pulled me back.
It was me. Even though i hated myself more than anyone else hated me, I was still all I
had when it came to safely carrying me down from that rooftop. A part of me believed I
should have jumped, therefore hated myself for not letting me do it. Another part of me
gained a newfound respect for myself since I saved myself. I was simultaneously my
own best friend and my own worst enemy , both my assassin and my protector, both all
I had and all I had.
With that realization I silently climbed down the ladder, then climbed down the staircase,
then entered my room and went to sleep.
My mom woke me up for breakfast just 4 hours later. She didn’t know that I was up all
night with my secret world-cleansing project. She thought I’d had enough sleep, even
though I had wanted to sleep for much, much longer.
I went to the dining room and had a cup of tea, and Bombay toasts made with the bread
and eggs I had bought the previous day. I didn’t know I’d stay alive to actually eat it. But
for someone reason I stayed, and the Bombay toast tasted great. That’s all my life had
boiled down to at that point – just tea and Bombay toasts, and nothing else felt real.
But at least I lived. And my stupid, delusional soul still thought I had a chance that
maybe someone will like me. So I kept looking.
I was open to both serious or casual relationships , depending on the girl.
I was thinking that if I have really strong feelings for a girl and she has similar feelings,
then I’ll gladly spend the rest of my life with her.
But if I have not-so-strong /neutral feelings towards a girl, then I won’t settle down with
her, but a casual friends-with-benefits kind of deal is okay .
Needless to say, not a single girl of the first category ever liked me back. They wanted
absolutely nothing to do with me, serious or casual or otherwise.
And that’s understandable, I can’t blame them.
But a lot of other girls from the second category did like me. But I didn’t like them back.
So according to my rule of thumb, these girls are what I would consider a potential
temporary friend-with-benefits , rather than a life partner.
But there was a problem. These second category ones didn’t want a casual fling. They
wanted to settle down with me, whereas I didn’t have similar feelings for them.
I’ve always heard of a certain type of girls that get a new temporary fuckbuddy every
few days, do everything and then cheat and/or find a new boy, – these girls would have
been perfect for my second category plan.

the fucking wall once in a while, neglectful to her feelings, cheats on her while also
being paranoid and suspicious of the woman’s loyalty –
Doesn’t matter . These kind of men will still be chosen , even though most people
including myself despise them.
Sure, it is possible for a man to be strong and good at the same time.
But in that case, the good would simply be a bonus and would not be the first priority. In
a jungle where the only rule is ‘eat or be eaten’, good can never be the first priority. If it
was , then we humans wouldn’t have come this far and the sabretooths would have
eaten a lot better.
The world Is a cruel and unfair place, a burning hellhole straight out of the immortal
works of Machiavelli , where being feared is better than being adored , where anything
is fair in love and war and survival and everything, and the rules of the jungle apply to
not just politics but everything,
and thriving here requires some ugly compromises.
And that is how ‘ Signal Jamming’ and ‘strength digging’ were born – to sacrifice
common sense and idealism in exchange for survival and natural selection. Because
nature was here first and we are simply guests . Nature is not obligated to play by our
rules that we made up later on.
Evolution doesn’t value moral standards or romanticism or happiness or equality or
noble virtues . It only rewards practicality. And the only practicality nature understands is
reproduction and multiplication. Even if it comes at a cost of your peace.
Because nature doesn’t give a shit.
Some might point out that, we no longer live in a prehistoric world. So why all this talk
about how ancient humans behaved?
That’s because our DNA still lives in the prehistoric times even though we live in a
modern world.
Our species has existed in this planet for at least a few hundred thousand years.
Earlier mammals and primates and hominid species who probably passed down a lot of
their genes to us, had been around since much longer.
And then things started to get spicy . We learned agriculture and language , formed
tribes and villages and civilizations and empires and stuff. We also learned a little bit of
science along the way .
And then recently things got really, really spicy . Around the 18
th
th
century the
industrial revolution took place when we were about 1 billion in global population , then
a bunch of other weird things went down such as TWO WORLD WARS, then the rise of
computers and internet and social media happened, most of our lives became one
elaborate mechanized rat race and our species reached a population of 8 billion. And all
of that , especially the last bit, happened within a span of just a few centuries. That is a
time period so short that it’s smaller than a fraction of a fraction of the blink of an eye on
the cosmic/evolutionary scale.
It all happened way too fast and our biology could not keep up.
A simple example of how we shot ourselves in the foot by outgrowing nature is ‘ The
Fight Or Flight response’
In case anyone doesn’t fully understand it , here’s a breakdown.
Suppose you’re out in the woods to gather berries or whatever and suddenly hear an
angry animal rushing towards you. You have two options. Either punch it in the face if
it’s somewhat the same size as you, or run for your life if it’s too big. Both of these
choices require energy, which comes from a complex reaction of nutrients and oxygen .
But the amount of both of these things in your body is limited , which means you’ll have
to switch gears and redistribute and improvise.
Your body will secrete some special neurotransmitters and hormones such as
norepinephrine and cortisol. These will bind to their respective receptors and trigger
temporary changes in your body like –
Raising your blood sugar so that your body has a lot of fuel readily available,
Increasing your heart rate and respiration so that there’s more blood and oxygen
flowing through you at any given moment ,
Shifting blood flow away from your digestive, reproductive , renal and reproductive
system and shunting it more towards your skeletal muscles so that you can use those
muscles to punch stuff or at least run away.
This doesn’t mean those other systems are unnecessary.
It’s just – making babies isn’t the most urgent thing to think about when you’re running
from angry mammoth.
Dangers like these are temporary and there will be plenty of time to digest and
reproduce later if you make it out of this alive.
However, the picture has changed a bit in our current lives. The problems now differ in 2
ways .
Firstly, the problems are no longer strictly physical.
We worry about education , jobs , finance, social and political issues, family
complications , relationship problems, mental health struggles and so on. You can’t
punch or run your way out of these . You might understandably want to punch your
colleagues, bosses or professors in the fucking face of course. But doing that probably
will not help. So the fight or flight response in these cases is just useless.
Also notice how these problems don’t just pop out for a few minutes and then disappear
again, for example like when a cave bear pops out near you and you manage to scare
it away with your spear, or maybe you kill it, or maybe you manage to escape, or maybe
it’ll kill you. One way or another, it should be over in a few minutes.
But the problems we have in modern times are more consistent and constantly looming
over our heads. Which means our fight or flight mode is staying active for an unnaturally
long amount of time, even though our body was not designed to handle that .
As a result, our bodies are bombarded by itself into being a shriveled , malnourished ,
broken mess all the time for no good reason. Then why does our body still use this
response?
Because evolution designed all our systems bit by bit over millions, or at least hundreds
of thousands of years. Throughout the majority of this long time, most of our modern
society problems didn’t exist because we still lived in jungles, hunting prey and fleeing
from predators . That’s what evolution had in mind while shaping us .
So if nature specifically designed you for one thing and then you suddenly shift to a
whole new lifestyle , then that’s your problem.
We may act like we’re better and different than all the other animals, better than what
we were 10,000 years ago. But at our very core, we are still essentially nothing but
prehistoric primates . We’re a bunch of violent , hairless monkeys in space suits with
guns, pretending like they have any clue what they’re doing.
So to me it makes perfect sense that we and everything we stand for are still secretly
and silently governed by our prehistoric monkey DNA. Sure, we don’t have to fight cave
bears and mammoths every morning. But we still have to fight and compete anyway.
The only difference is, the hunting for food is now replaced by buying food. The ability
to hunt is replaced by ability to buy, AKA money. Money now is what muscles and
spears were millennia ago.
Back then, nature wrote into our genes “thou shall choose the partner who is capable
of throwing the hardest punch”.
Because back then, punching was strength. And strength meant survival .
In modern society, those exact genes will say “ thou shall choose the man with more
money”. Because now , money is strength. And strength means survival.
So that explains gold-digging. But what about digging of the other things like
personality traits?
Well , the qualities generally associated with ‘conventional manliness’ – like confidence
and leadership and competence, are usually indicators of strength. That doesn’t mean
someone’s personality alone can disintegrate a predator just by looking at it. But there
usually is a correlation.
In other words, if a person isn’t directly displaying physical strength and hunting skills
but is acting like he owns the place, then there is a high chance he might actually be
strong. Or at least that’s the association our monkey brains have made over the years.
Besides, most of our real life interactions have now been made speaking-based
anyway. From ordering a pizza to calling a taxi , from asking for directions to shopping,
from job interviews and exams to actually doing a high status job –
Pretty much everything requires talking, similar to how most things required physical
strength and endurance in the old days.
Skilled at speaking has become the new sexy.
Personality, knowledge , ability to form social bonds and solve problems – have become
the new strength.
And strength means survival.
So to my question from earlier, is love ‘ gold digging’ or ‘personality digging’ ,
The answer would be – none.
It’s actually strength-digging. It’s survival-digging.
No matter how much we romanticize it and pretend like we’re nature’s special, favorite
baby that’s just better than everyone else - we’re nothing but detailed flesh-puppets
dancing on strings made of DNA strands, monkeys trained on nothing but the oldest
rules of the jungle . We’re nothing but slaves of nature.
As long as your species population isn’t going down, anything goes.
If you’re one of the unlucky bastards that don’t possess ‘evolution-approved
digging-worthy qualities’ ,
then nature will tell you to go fuck yourself,
and that your mental health and happiness can go to hell.
Because nature doesn’t give a shit.
We were given more intelligence and sophistication than any other creature on Earth.
Because that was supposed to help us survive and reproduce more.
And this strategy certainly worked as we’ve clearly become the single most powerful
species in the world and we pretty much run the whole planet.
But with that added intelligence, came added evil and greed and sadism. Because
peace, compassion and kindness are not the most effective tool to survive and thrive.
Dirty, brute force will always be stronger than empathy.
Which is why a lot of other species got driven into extinction because of us.
And we fucked up the whole climate and ecosystem, raised the global temperature at
record-breaking rates, and filled our oceans with plastic.
And of course we kill and maim and bomb our own brothers and sisters , because we’ve
gone blind from the limitless thirst for power.
So what?
Nature doesn’t give a shit.
And what about all the other garbage that comes with intelligence?
What about the crushing weight of sentience, the never-ending ice-cold stabbing glare
of our consciousness trying to break itself free?
Why did the universe give us the capacity to ask questions about our existence, and
then refused to give us any answers?
Why did it make us just smart enough to know that we’re stupid , but not smart enough
to change it?
Why did it set us free in the incomprehensible , infinite abyss of the cosmos just to make
us feel small, and then proceeded to fill our minds with even greater voids of our own?
Why did nature make survival so competitive that it’s necessary to fit in , and then also
make us frail and complex and diverse enough so that we can’t fit in?
‘cause fuck you that’s why .
It’s Because nature doesn’t a shit.
I thought and thought a lot and then thought a bit more for good measure.
And eventually found the answer to my questions -
is love real?
Does existence have a meaning?
Is living really worth it?
And the answers were neither ‘yes’ or ‘no’.
It was – it doesn’t matter.
Because fuck nature that’s why.
if the very rules of being are written by an invisible hand that seemingly hates me, then
the only way to play is to ignore its rules altogether and make up my own.
If evolution will be happy to see me as either ‘ unfit for survival’ or as its ‘ naturally
selected puppet’, then i should not give it that happiness at all .
If everything in the whole universe including myself wants me dead, then simply staying
alive is ‘Signal Jamming’.
If nature tells me that I should die,
Then I should stay alive even if it is for the sole reason to throw a middle finger at
nature’s face.
Because nature sucks.
And I don’t give a shit.
Maybe love really is something divine that our minds can’t grasp, a dance of souls that
transcends all logic and defies all laws.
Or maybe it is just a neuro-biochemical scam designed to trick humans into procreating
Either way– it doesn’t matter.
Life is too short for chasing answers. I learned that the hard way.
Even if the universe scams you, you realize it but you enjoy and want it anyway , then
you shouldn’t see it as a scam after all. Not everything has to be a game, and not every
game needs to have rules, especially in a world where rules are usually as shitty as ‘eat
or be eaten’.
I hope all of us get to experience this short ride on this tiny space rock in our own silly
ways, no matter as how ‘unfit for survival’ nature labels us.
I hope all of us get to experience peace, compassion and kindness at least once; and
realize that it may not be the most effective tool to survive , but it is enough to make us
feel alive.
Even in the old days of being prehistoric murder-monkeys we were capable of
compassion, evident from the fact that humans with broken bones were protected by
their fellow humans until they could heal.
I hope we don’t forget that.
I hope no one ever reaches a point in life when they find themselves standing on the
rooftop with a sharp instrument in hand.
In the very unfortunate circumstances when you do find yourself in that spot, then I
hope there will be at least two people to drag you away from the edge and I hope one of
those two people is yourself.
I hope your life is constantly filled with fragments of joy, such as unexpected Bombay
toasts in the morning.
And I hope you’ll always have someone by your side to share them with.

content: On November 4th, 2021, my younger brother told my mom that he’s having a sudden
craving for Bombay toasts. For those who don’t know, it means sliced bread fried in
battered eggs and oil.
I overheard their conversation and thought I’ll buy some eggs and bread when I go out
in the evening so that my family can have some Bombay toasts the next morning.
Maybe I wouldn’t be there with them, maybe my family wouldn’t be in the mental state to
eat. But I thought it’d be a nice thing to do anyway.
When I was outside, I texted a friend of mine to grab a smoke for 5 minutes. It was the
same friend with whom I had my very first cigarette 5 years earlier. It’s poetic that my
last cigarette was going to be with him too, although my friend standing a few feet away
from me didn’t know that I was planning to kill myself that night.
At around 4-5 AM of November 5th, I quietly went to the rooftop with a pair of sharp
scissors and my suicide note in hand. The goal of the scissors was to slice my throat
just before jumping off from the rooftop as an extra layer of guarantee to my death. A 50
foot drop to the solid pavement should have been already enough to kill me anyway, but
I wanted to sprinkle in some additional blood loss in there . Because…..why not?
My handwritten suicide note said something along the lines of –
“ excuse the mess.
I , Nafiz Bin Hafiz, age 23, in full consciousness, am confirming that no one other than
myself is responsible for my death, and that my cause of death is hornyness.
I know dying from hornyness in a world where people are dying from heart disease,
cancer, diabetes, starvation, lack of clean water, war crimes etc is a wee bit outrageous.
But it is what it is.
Some might suggest ‘ if you’re not having sex but you would like to, then why not just
pay a prostitute?’
While I’m thankful for their input and have no personal hatred or judgement towards
prostitution, I would have to disagree to such suggestions . Because these people are
missing the whole point.
Because sex is not about sex.
It’s about what the sex means. It’s about the implication that sex carries behind its back.
When a woman has sex with me, she’s not just simply having sex with me. She’s doing
a lot more than just that. She’s making a conscious decision that her urge to have sex
with me is stronger than her urge to conform to other things like moral, social,
evolutionary and religious values. She’s making a comparison between me and
something else, and then declaring me as the winner. That win means something.
She’s concluding that I’m not a loser but rather a lovable person overall , someone
who’s worthy of what he’s about to have, someone who’s worth the sacrifice.
Being that someone means something.
Not everyone will deem me worthy of being that someone , of course. That is normal .
But if not a single person ever has deemed me worthy of being that someone, then that
could indicate something is terribly wrong with me.
If anyone just pays a few bucks to have sex, then he’s certainly having sex . But he’s
not getting everything else I just mentioned. It has become a much more simplified
transaction that says nothing about the likability and personal worth of that person. It is
still sex, but now without the underlying meaning.
So you could say I’m not dying from hornyness, but rather dying from the crushing
weight of being a possibly unworthy unlovable waste of oxygen.
Once again, excuse the mess.”
I remember standing on the railing that morning, looking straight down towards the
cement pavement 50 feet below with the large pair of scissors fully opened up to be
used like a knife . The light breeze brushing against my body was probably trying its
best to push me down. The ground below looked seductively comfortable, deathly
magnetic, as if its trying its best to pull me down. Despite the best efforts of everything I
didn’t really jump off that day. Because someone stopped me. I’m not talking about God,
but rather a person who pulled me back.
It was me. Even though i hated myself more than anyone else hated me, I was still all I
had when it came to safely carrying me down from that rooftop. A part of me believed I
should have jumped, therefore hated myself for not letting me do it. Another part of me
gained a newfound respect for myself since I saved myself. I was simultaneously my
own best friend and my own worst enemy , both my assassin and my protector, both all
I had and all I had.
With that realization I silently climbed down the ladder, then climbed down the staircase,
then entered my room and went to sleep.
My mom woke me up for breakfast just 4 hours later. She didn’t know that I was up all
night with my secret world-cleansing project. She thought I’d had enough sleep, even
though I had wanted to sleep for much, much longer.
I went to the dining room and had a cup of tea, and Bombay toasts made with the bread
and eggs I had bought the previous day. I didn’t know I’d stay alive to actually eat it. But
for someone reason I stayed, and the Bombay toast tasted great. That’s all my life had
boiled down to at that point – just tea and Bombay toasts, and nothing else felt real.
But at least I lived. And my stupid, delusional soul still thought I had a chance that
maybe someone will like me. So I kept looking.
I was open to both serious or casual relationships , depending on the girl.
I was thinking that if I have really strong feelings for a girl and she has similar feelings,
then I’ll gladly spend the rest of my life with her.
But if I have not-so-strong /neutral feelings towards a girl, then I won’t settle down with
her, but a casual friends-with-benefits kind of deal is okay .
Needless to say, not a single girl of the first category ever liked me back. They wanted
absolutely nothing to do with me, serious or casual or otherwise.
And that’s understandable, I can’t blame them.
But a lot of other girls from the second category did like me. But I didn’t like them back.
So according to my rule of thumb, these girls are what I would consider a potential
temporary friend-with-benefits , rather than a life partner.
But there was a problem. These second category ones didn’t want a casual fling. They
wanted to settle down with me, whereas I didn’t have similar feelings for them.
I’ve always heard of a certain type of girls that get a new temporary fuckbuddy every
few days, do everything and then cheat and/or find a new boy, – these girls would have
been perfect for my second category plan.
But sadly – they were like Bigfoot to me. Because I kept hearing about them all my life,
but I could never actually find one, as if they were separated from me by a magical
forcefield.
It’s like they were mythical creatures, urban legends straight out of story books. All I
found in my actual experience were traditional girls looking for something serious and
committed .
So were all those girls that just ‘use and throw away’ one man after another - were
they not real? Are they just an exaggerated myth?
Or was I so extremely unlikable that these girls simply didn’t see me worthy of their
exploitation?
Was my value really that low? So low that not only the so-called good girls were staying
away from me, but even the so-called bad girls were hiding from me as well?
As if it wasn’t bad enough to be lower a normal human worthy of love ? Now I also had
to be in an inferior position than soulless disposable toys, even in the eyes of people
that don’t care about the other person’s feelings?
Anyways, back to the story of girls having serious feelings for me even though I didn’t
have similar feelings towards them.
A lot of guys in this scenario would actually lie . They’d say “ yes yes of course I love
you, of course my intentions are serious , of course I’m not going just leave you after we
have sex.
now come on lets get laid so that I can not dump you later on.”
And then of course these guys would have sex and then dump the girls later on based
on whatever garbage excuse they can make up.
What makes this scenario even more complicated is that even a lot of girls that do want
casual relationships, girls that have had dozens of boyfriends and have a new one
every month - even those girls never directly admit that they’re looking for a casual
relationship. They always claim that they’re seriously in love every time, even though
they never are. ( I myself met such girls , although much later in life). They even go out
of their way to constantly post on social media about how disgusted they are by
premarital relationships and men in general. It’s a confusing, misleading, hypocritical
world out there.
That means every time a girl said she seriously loved me, there’s a chance she’s
actually lying and wants to have some short-term fun – which is awesome. So I guess I
should also just lie and falsely claim that I love her too, and then breakup with her after
the deed is done and she won’t actually be sad about it .
But again, what if the girl was not lying? In that case I’d be lying to innocent people for
my personal gain and thubecome the same thing as the very species I hate the most –
politicians.
so i had basically two options.
A) Lie , cheat, manipulate, take advantage, then leave .
B) Stay honest AKA stay a virgin loser.
I was never really a good person by any means and have done many wrong things. But
I am proud to say that, at least in this one sector in life, I chose transparency over greed
or lust.
Those girls were of course not happy with my answer. It was an honest answer , but it
was not the answer they were hoping for.
And so they left. But at least their departure meant that they weren’t lying and I did the
right thing by not lying to them.
So.. hurrayy, I guess?
I chose honesty AKA the best policy. And as a reward for my virtue , a fairy rose up from
a river and gifted me an iron virginity, a silver virginity and a gold virginity.
It wasn’t much, but it gave me just enough strength to carry on with my journey.
The most perplexing yet most flattering part of this journey was the widespread rumor
that I was a prolific playboy. Not a wannabe playboy that tries a lot and fails – but
instead an actual playboy that tries a lot and succeeds.
The trying part wasn't really a rumor . It was true and obvious . of course I tried. But the
success part was artificially added on by other people without my knowledge, through
some kind of Chinese Telephone magic.
While I took people’s high assumption of me as a compliment, I still think they used it as
a derogatory term and that they meant to shame and insult me. Moreover the sheer
inaccuracy of their belief was fascinating.
It's like I have iron deficiency, but the doctors diagnose me with iron overload.
I guess you could say it’s –
Ironic.
Fast forward a few years.
I was now 27-28 years old.
My skin no longer felt like a torture cell.
I no longer had tendencies to go on dubious rooftop adventures.
And now I was in love. With myself.
Like all the ancient fairy tales, I had fallen in love with my knight in shining armor –
myself .
My dating account also saw a few changes.
I also learned a lot about myself and what exactly sets me apart from most other
people.
The most notable one being – I’m a fucking antinatalist, or what most people simply call
“crazy retard”. I’ve been so since 2018-19.
That by itself eliminates 99% of women from my potential wife list and makes things
already pretty hard.
Even if antinatalism wasn’t an issue, there is something else that singlehandedly
makes love straight-up impossible for me.
I noticed that I’m cold , boring, uncaring and distant ( at least in real life ) ,
I’m quite good at logically anticipating , analyzing , calculating and explaining emotions,
like a fucking clanker ,
But I had extreme difficulty processing emotions and showing affection like a normal
human being.
Social situations feel like the trenches of an active warzone,
And human interaction continues to suffocate me, despite decades of experience and
exposure which should have improved things by now but hasn’t , which means no
amount of practice and repetition will probably cure me.
The fact that I’m bad at talking, and most traits associated with conventional ‘manliness’
are also either directly or indirectly associated with talking – that certainly doesn’t help.
I know for a fact that no girl on earth will ever be happy with me and can’t lead a normal
human life while being my wife, no matter how much she says cinematic dialogue like “
you’re perfect the way you are and I’m totally okay with this and I swear that I
understand you and I promise to keep you happy forever “.
People tend to overestimate themselves when they let their emotions do the talking .
Reality isn’t a cinema, promises made under the spell of infatuation shouldn’t count, and
their sappy , filmy, poetic quotes will only stand for the first few months/years at best.
Quirky abnormal weirdos like me may seem fascinating , fun and cute from a distance ,
in small doses and preferably on a TV screen, but a real life human relationship with
someone like that is not sustainable and in the long term it will feel like genuine torture.
If I get married, that marriage will be something I have to fearfully survive and my wife
will have to painfully tolerate . And that’s not how a relationship should be. Love should
be a place of peace and comfort, not a constant battle with yourself.
So I upgraded my dating goals too based on my new findings. In the past I’d plan to
have either a serious or casual relationship depending on the girl. Now I decided I’ll only
accept casual relationships and never promise a lifetime commitment with any girl at all,
for obvious reasons.
After I reached a certain age , my mom started bringing up marriage a lot. She would
keep nagging me for hours or even days on end about when I’m going to get married ,
and she has some good proposals and etc.
I understood her motivation of course. I was 11 years old when my father died, my
younger brother was 6. And ever since then my mother - a housewife relying on her
dead husband’s lower-middle class pension – had to raise these two sons on her own.
If I reflect back on her parenting skills now through the objective lens of a neutral ,
rational adult, I wouldn’t say she was perfect parent, or even a very good parent. But
she tried her best.
And now that I was a doctor , my already proud mother was just 1 step away from being
prouder and officially being declared a successful mother who completed her
responsibility .
It made sense that she’d want me to get married and suck the invisible , proverbial
cock of society. After all , that’s literally what most people’s lives revolve around –
flexing on society , impressing people that don’t give a fuck about you. My mother was
no exception.
I have no problem with making my mother happy though. In fact I’ve listened to almost
everything my mom said throughout all my life, including things I didn’t agree with and
things that made me a loser in the eyes of other people.
If it’s in my power to help someone, and helping them doesn’t cost me anything, then I
will help them even if they’re a total stranger. But in this case, helping my mom would
mean throwing myself and my future wife in a fucking wood-chipper so that we could
spend our lives in constant toxicity and incompatibility and regret.
Did I have a desire to help my mother by listening to her? Yes.
But is that desire strong enough to intentionally ruin my own life and turn it into living
hell and drag another innocent girl along with me in the process? No. And if that makes
me a selfish monster, then so be it.
I tried to calmly explain my situation to my mother. I told her I was different , I didn’t
choose to be like this, and any person should have the freedom to live his own life in his
own way.
My mother unsurprisingly did the most normal motherly response ever by being
inconsiderate about my issues and acted like I was being a fucking piece of shit for no
reason and she was the victim in this situation.
We’d sometimes have some heated arguments, she’d go on for days or even weeks
without saying a word to me despite living in the same house, and she’d give this
disgusted, angry expression at me as if she was expecting to see her son, but instead
was greeted by this amorphous bloody blob made of rotting flesh, cockroach eggs, dog
shit and skunk semen .
Maybe she was right. I don’t know. Either way it didn’t really matter. I had run out of my
ability to care a long time ago anyway.
Meanwhile,
Impressing girls was mysteriously becoming easier. Maybe I looked better now. Or
maybe my personality and speaking skills had gotten better. Maybe I reached closer to
the concept of what women would consider “husband material uWu” one way or
another.
In the year 2025 alone – when I was 26-27 , at least 3-4 different girls from my medical
college had expressed interest in being my girlfriend and eventually my wife.
This exact thing would have been a dream come true just a few years earlier. This was
specifically what I was looking for at some point. But by the time I actually did find these
women, I was no longer the same person I was before.
Before 2021, even girls who knew me for years wouldn’t agree to anything like this.
And in 2025, girls were agreeing to this within just 2-4 weeks of knowing me. They
agreed to all this even though I constantly told them that I don’t have any emotions and I
won’t ever get married. This contrast was unbelievable. I was getting more than I could
ever possibly wish for, except now I no longer wished for it because somewhere along
the journey I had changed. Maybe I had left a part of me back in that rooftop, and I can’t
seem to find it no matter how many times I go back to pick it back up. I had promised
myself that I’d never fall in love with anyone else again, and I found it necessary to keep
that promise. After all, the promise was made by myself , to myself, against other
people. Because other people didn’t pull me back from that rooftop that morning. Myself
did. All other people did was to only push me up there in the first place.
Some might think my promise was a variation of the quote “if you didn’t love me when I
was unattractive, then you don’t deserve me when I’m attractive” .
But that quote is actually kind of unfair and pure nonsense.
Because why would anyone be attracted to someone who’s not attractive?
If any random girl approached me, would I always accept her whether I find her
attractive or not? No I wouldn’t. I would always have the personal freedom to choose
my partner and therefore reject anyone for whatever reason I want.
Maybe objective attractiveness isn’t a real thing and thus I’d only reject them based on
my subjective definition of attractive, but my decision would always be valid regardless.
It’s my choice and I have the right to make it.
The same applies to everyone. Everyone rejected me because they had the right to do

A simple example of how we shot ourselves in the foot by outgrowing nature is ‘ The
Fight Or Flight response’
In case anyone doesn’t fully understand it , here’s a breakdown.
Suppose you’re out in the woods to gather berries or whatever and suddenly hear an
angry animal rushing towards you. You have two options. Either punch it in the face if
it’s somewhat the same size as you, or run for your life if it’s too big. Both of these
choices require energy, which comes from a complex reaction of nutrients and oxygen .
But the amount of both of these things in your body is limited , which means you’ll have
to switch gears and redistribute and improvise.
Your body will secrete some special neurotransmitters and hormones such as
norepinephrine and cortisol. These will bind to their respective receptors and trigger
temporary changes in your body like –
Raising your blood sugar so that your body has a lot of fuel readily available,
Increasing your heart rate and respiration so that there’s more blood and oxygen
flowing through you at any given moment ,
Shifting blood flow away from your digestive, reproductive , renal and reproductive
system and shunting it more towards your skeletal muscles so that you can use those
muscles to punch stuff or at least run away.
This doesn’t mean those other systems are unnecessary.
It’s just – making babies isn’t the most urgent thing to think about when you’re running
from angry mammoth.
Dangers like these are temporary and there will be plenty of time to digest and
reproduce later if you make it out of this alive.

Even in the old days of being prehistoric murder-monkeys we were capable of
compassion, evident from the fact that humans with broken bones were protected by
their fellow humans until they could heal.
I hope we don’t forget that.
I hope no one ever reaches a point in life when they find themselves standing on the
rooftop with a sharp instrument in hand.
In the very unfortunate circumstances when you do find yourself in that spot, then I
hope there will be at least two people to drag you away from the edge and I hope one of
those two people is yourself.
I hope your life is constantly filled with fragments of joy, such as unexpected Bombay
toasts in the morning.
And I hope you’ll always have someone by your side to share them with.

title: Auras of Emotions
author: Aoi Yume
imageAlt: Cover image for Auras of Emotions

runs.text: What if we all had auras of Emotion? What if
every time
we were sad the aura around us would change
color
! What if our inner conflict could be reflected in the
color
of our aura at the moment?
Will this make life a little less tougher?
A little less cruel?
Will this make people understand us better?
I wonder!
Now, What
should the
colors
be? Happiness should be Yellow with golden spark.
What if you're feeling blessed ?? Feeling thankful ?? Finally feeling Peaceful! This
color
must be white, The purest
color
of all.
The
Color
of Inner child, the little innocent voice inside us that most of us often ignore
! It s
hould be the most beautiful shade of pink. Pink, the
color
of Innocence.
& When you're feeling safe and Secured in your life, you're feeling comfortable in your own skin, The
Color
green should do the trick here. Green, The
color
of Nature, should also be the
color
of safety.
And the
color
of Being loved? Purple it is! No other
color
can represent Love more than Purple. Purple represent love in it's every form.
Motherly
love, fatherly love, sisterly love, brotherly love, friendly love
romantic love, spiritual love, all forms of love.
Jealousy or you can also call it
Envy, is
a strong negative emotion, Orange it is. The
color
of jealousy should be orange.
What should be the
color
of insecurities? Doubts? I'll pick brown for it.
Anger, we
all know the
colour
of anger, It's Red, The
color
of Anger is the
color
of blood.
For Guilt I'll pick Ash. Guilt that make us feel so small that we
want to
burn ourselves into ashes and disappear.
Sadness should be blue for sure!!Blue in invisible excruciating sadness.
Grieve should be
Navy
Blue, almost black yet not so black.
What if you're feeling like dying? Like you are drowning in a
pit load
of endless darkness and you can't help but keep drowning, there's nothing to hold into !! What
color
should represent this feeling ?? Black it is! Black is Beauty we all say, One of my
favorite
color
but it also represent sadness beyond imagination, hopelessness.
Now that we've decided most of the
colors
of emotion, let's go back to the core of the topic. Understanding each other a little better. Not to trigger each other's feelings. Make each other feel safe in this cruel beautiful world. These
colors
should help us, no? Make "dealing with each other" a little bit easier!
But these auras,
colors
of emotion, all of this is a mere fantasy, a hypothesis, not something concrete or real. We don't have these visible auras or
colors
of emotion. Real world is neither a piece of fiction nor something magical yet miracles do happen to
us, real
people.
Even
though
we don't have visible
Auras, we

do have something inside us, Something that makes us human. That is none other than Our humanity, our instinct. We always catch on the strong emotions that the person associating with us is feeling. We just choose to ignore it most of the time as it feels like a burden to make the burden of other lighter.
Maybe We are born selfish. I, me, my, myself
. m

any of us can't get out of these terms. We don't really have time for others.  We don't care if someone around us is feeling like dying. And even if that person end up dying, we won't care! At least we are safe and sound, we are not dying.

In the same way, we also don't care if someone fall victim of some cruel soul-shattering crime rather we feel relieved that we weren't the victim. As long as it's not us, it doesn't matter to us at all. Even if we had the
colors

of emotion, we would probably just act blind. After all, we only care about us. The rest of the world can burn itself down. As long as the flame is far away from us, we'll be okay. We don't have time for others. All our life we only think about ourselves.
Human is a species that fall under the kingdom
Animalia

& are called mammals . So, yes, we all are indeed Mammals but not all of us are really human. Why?? Cause to be a human, what we truly and surely need is humanity, Empathy. Without it we can be many things but not human.
Shouldn't we try to be human first?  Shouldn't we claim our root first?
Aren't we
Ashraful
Maklukat
? we really are called the Greatest of all living being.
Then Shouldn't we do things that are  also greatest?
Shouldn't we be the kindest of all? Shouldn't we be a safe place for another human being?
Please reflect on yourself. Stand before the mirror and ask yourself:
What makes me, Me?
What makes me
human?
What I see when I look at my reflection?
Do I see a kind person or a Cruel person
Do I see a Genuine person or a fake person?
Do I see a person I always wanted to be?
Am I proud of who I am?
Can I claim to be a good person?
Can I claim to be a Human Being?

At the end of the day being a sparkling star in the darkest of night is what matters the most. Make sure the light in you is shining radiantly and vibrantly. Your light should be the source of hope to the people around you. You should bring people around you peace not chaos.
I'm sure if we can be a constant source of light, comfort & warmth to others, when our own light dim along the course of life, Someone's else light will enlighten us with hope and comfort.
"I be your sparkling star in your darkest night & you be mine when my own light fails me"

& When you're feeling safe and Secured in your life, you're feeling comfortable in your own skin, The Color green should do the trick here. Green, The color of Nature, should also be the color of safety.

And the color of Being loved? Purple it is! No other color can represent Love more than Purple. Purple represent love in it's every form. Motherly love, fatherly love, sisterly love, brotherly love, friendly love, romantic love, spiritual love, all forms of love.
Jealousy or you can also call it Envy, is a strong negative emotion, Orange it is. The color of jealousy should be orange.
What should be the color of insecurities? Doubts? I'll pick brown for it.
Anger, we all know the colour of anger, It's Red, The color of Anger is the color of blood.
For Guilt I'll pick Ash. Guilt that make us feel so small that we want to burn ourselves into ashes and disappear.
Sadness should be blue for sure!!Blue in invisible excruciating sadness.
Grieve should be Navy Blue, almost black yet not so black.

What if you're feeling like dying? Like you are drowning in a pit load of endless darkness and you can't help but keep drowning, there's nothing to hold into !! What color should represent this feeling ?? Black it is! Black is Beauty we all say, One of my favorite color but it also represent sadness beyond imagination, hopelessness.

Now that we've decided most of the colors of emotion, let's go back to the core of the topic. Understanding each other a little better. Not to trigger each other's feelings. Make each other feel safe in this cruel beautiful world. These colors should help us, no? Make "dealing with each other" a little bit easier!

But these auras, colors of emotion, all of this is a mere fantasy, a hypothesis, not something concrete or real. We don't have these visible auras or colors of emotion. Real world is neither a piece of fiction nor something magical yet miracles do happen to us, real people.

Even though we don't have visible Auras, we do have something inside us, Something that makes us human. That is none other than Our humanity, our instinct. We always catch on the strong emotions that the person associating with us is feeling. We just choose to ignore it most of the time as it feels like a burden to make the burden of other lighter.

Maybe We are born selfish. I, me, my, myself. many of us can't get out of these terms. We don't really have time for others.  We don't care if someone around us is feeling like dying. And even if that person end up dying, we won't care! At least we are safe and sound, we are not dying.

In the same way, we also don't care if someone fall victim of some cruel soul-shattering crime rather we feel relieved that we weren't the victim. As long as it's not us, it doesn't matter to us at all. Even if we had the colors of emotion, we would probably just act blind. After all, we only care about us. The rest of the world can burn itself down. As long as the flame is far away from us, we'll be okay. We don't have time for others. All our life we only think about ourselves.

Human is a species that fall under the kingdom Animalia & are called mammals . So, yes, we all are indeed Mammals but not all of us are really human. Why?? Cause to be a human, what we truly and surely need is humanity, Empathy. Without it we can be many things but not human.
Shouldn't we try to be human first?  Shouldn't we claim our root first?
Aren't we Ashraful Maklukat? we really are called the Greatest of all living being.
Then Shouldn't we do things that are  also greatest?
Shouldn't we be the kindest of all? Shouldn't we be a safe place for another human being?
Please reflect on yourself. Stand before the mirror and ask yourself:
What makes me, Me?
What makes me, human?
What I see when I look at my reflection?
Do I see a kind person or a Cruel person?
Do I see a Genuine person or a fake person?
Do I see a person I always wanted to be?
Am I proud of who I am?
Can I claim to be a good person?
Can I claim to be a Human Being?

At the end of the day being a sparkling star in the darkest of night is what matters the most. Make sure the light in you is shining radiantly and vibrantly. Your light should be the source of hope to the people around you. You should bring people around you peace not chaos.
I'm sure if we can be a constant source of light, comfort & warmth to others, when our own light dim along the course of life, Someone's else light will enlighten us with hope and comfort.
"I be your sparkling star in your darkest night & you be mine when my own light fails me"

runs.text: When your life revolves a lot around the responsibility of caregiving – to the point you have to
become a parent-like figure for your parent, people can't help but pity. It is natural for them to
feel sorry for an intelligent kid who stayed back home when all her buddies grew their wings and
flew abroad; who barely got through school because of fragmented sleep from waking up
multiple times a night to help with washroom visits; who wakes up early every single day to not
miss morning meds, no matter how exhausted. From holding down my father’s legs to stop the
severe tremors, to now wiping drool that his mouth can never hold – their sighs have only grown
louder and deeper.
In the initial years when the signs and symptoms started to settle in, I was in outrageous denial
of how our lives were changing. As a teenager with your own battles to fight: school grades,
extracurriculars, growing friendships, it is unsettling to witness an essential figure’s diminishing
participation in your life. Every time tuition classes ended I dreaded being picked up by my weak
and shabby looking father while everyone else’s dads drove them home in their Premios. He
would regularly show up, stubborn to fulfill his duties, until one evening. Pa was sitting right
outside the gate, sitting but completely frozen from bradykinesia. My friends walked past with
smirks and some even laughing, as I struggled to move dad onto a rickshaw, my face hot from
the embarrassment as well as anger, which I unashamedly let out on him right after getting
home. I doubt I will ever be able to forgive younger me, let alone those “friends”.
It is unimaginably brutal to watch someone who is your biggest cheerleader and ever so funny,
kind, athletic, artistic and sunshine in human form, gradually getting defeated by a terminal and
treacherous illness. From the outside it seems like being locked into a tunnel with no light at the
end – like I am bringing up a child which is growing in reverse. Except, my tunnel has countless
windows, installed by the child. Caregiving for a Parkinson’s patient consists of handling a lot of
bladder accidents, random infections and mobility struggles. Lots of ER visits from injuries.
Hallucinations, delusions, and the list goes on. But caregiving is also witnessing a sleepy and
frail Pops trying his best to cooperate with diaper changing in the middle of the night, or when
being given a shower; receiving soft pats and the gentlest smile when I recite Quran before
bedtime; sitting in the doctor’s waiting room and seeing him make friends left and right; not
remembering my major but ensuring I buy a present and flowers for Mom’s birthday.
There may be no financial or materialistic gains from this full time job, but to be able to make life
the slightest bit easier for someone so vulnerable, someone who does not have anything to offer
but lessons in compassion and grace, brings a profound level of contentment. This kind of
contentment no one could fathom unless in these shoes. Inexpressibly beautiful is the
unconditionality of such a bond, without expecting any worldly reward but only that within. I am
appreciative of many blessings we often take for granted, like walking around freely, eating with
ease without spilling, getting up with a fit body, and having the privilege to use my senses fully
and learn and work freely. I am indebted to my body for its ability to control basic functions.
Having to interpret his words makes me thankful for my voice,which increases my drive to use
my clear speech to never speak ill or hurtfully but only beneficially. Seeing his unreadable
handwriting makes me appreciate the ability to write. His struggles remind me to cherish what I
have and make my life worthwhile. He may not bring me my favorite shawarma after getting off
work anymore, but I make sure to get his beloved sweet and sour corn when I return home.
Loud roars of thunder frighten me and I run to my dad, but somehow I forget that now I have to
hold tight his tiny trembling body – one that was my fortress of shelter from any storm the world
threw my way. Yet it is my greatest fortune to have the opportunity to be that for Pa in this
lifetime, to be able to display in myself a fraction of the traits he always set an example for.
ارً ﯾﻐِ ﺻَ ﻲﻧِ ﺎﯾَ ﺑﱠ رَ ﺎﻣَ ﻛَ ﺎﻣَ ﮭُ ﻣْ ﺣَ رْ ا بﱢ رﱠ
Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera
"My Lord, have mercy upon them [my parents] as they brought me up [when I was] small."

runs.text: Dear Old Friend,
I am sorry.
I dreamt of you today, again. I saw your smile and the same carefree delight you used to hold
yourself with when we first became friends. You and I, in an impossible afternoon of carefree
fields and freedom. To run as far as eyes could go. The sun warming my heart and my soul as
you giggled on and on and on. The open sky over our heads. And no dead bugs under our feet.
I woke up with tears around my eyes and this hollow ache somewhere in my chest I haven't felt
in years now. I miss you. And I am sure you miss me too. If not in genuine sorrow than in favor
of fond nostalgia.
This is not my first letter to you. I thought, this afternoon, that I'd finally finish that letter I was
writing to you during the pandemic. The one I never even got the chance to tell you about. But
then I remembered I didn't have it anymore. The termites had wormed their way around the hard
slippery plywood and found the soft gritty underbelly of the drawer and feasted their way into the
paper and the wood in its concealed locked crevice. Along with all the letters you wrote to me
over the years. I thought I had secured it from the prying hands when I laid claim on the drawer
with the lock. But
হায়
, I hadn't considered the damage a thousand tiny things can do.
Do you remember the letters? When internet explorer was a “virus” in our dads computers and
our mothers would get angry at the 2 taka cost of each text. You always got your spellings
wrong but you still tried to write a few sentences in English because that was ‘my thing’. I wish
you knew how much care I'd kept them with. But despite it all, it couldn't survive time in a sealed
box, I suppose. I did, however, find 2 papers stapled together in the pile of barely rescued
treasures. It was from class 5, my internet access was still under lockdown and you had taken
the time to carefully write down the lyrics of the song I had recorded from FM Radio in pretty
pink paper. Not because I had asked, but because you remembered when you heard me
humming it during Math class and saw me get frustrated over lyrics I could not remember.
The words are mocking me now, in your round neat handwriting, “Prithibi ta naki choto hote
hote.” funny isn't it? Now I have my own phone, and unrestricted internet access. And I watch
your face pop up on my ‘recommended’ on every social media. And I stare at your toothy smile
in front of the “naamkora university” and I scroll away.
But I think of you. I think of you often. It is hard not to when you've spent a decade with
someone by your side.
A prominent phrase in us girls and women's lives, “Meye manush er kisher best friend”, or
“Meyeder bondhutto cheleder moto gobhir hoy naki?”, or most prominently-
“Biyer por kothayy ke chole jabe!”
It used to make me enraged. Now I am just… tired. And I think of you.
We did indeed stop talking. We did grow apart when you moved schools. But was it the innate
evil femininity within us that stopped us from breaking the boundaries of everything and deciding
to meet again? Is it the jealousy within me that stops me from reaching out to you again?
We did grow apart. But the rope hadn't snapped in immediate tension. It was the pulling and the
fraying and the ripping that finally cut the ties between us. But I still hold the pieces of me that
once knew your presence to my core. Maybe, it was when your mom scolded you when I placed
higher than you. Maybe, it was when my mother came into the class and separated me from our
designated middle bench and forced me to the first. Maybe it was when others tried to sort us
into tables of ‘better ats’ And ‘worse thans’. Maybe it was the several miscommunications and
misunderstandings and forced formalities that left us feeling a little more distant. It was when my
teenage experiments and secrets were pried open and picked apart that my parents had
accused you of my “ruin”. And I could not stand up for our friendship.
I am sorry.
I think of the several times my father accused that you were trying to “put me behind” , that “this
is what friends do” And that I was too naive to understand your schemes. But I could never raise
my voice another octave higher, and instead I thought of the times you scrunched your brows in
concern over my future. Sternly and pleadingly telling me to focus on my board exams, that my
mother is sick and she couldn't handle the stress of my falling grades. I thought of the times you
took the time to remind me of every tutorial and mocktests and tests and coaching dates. When
you tilted your math paper
juust
so, because you knew I hadn't practiced for the C.T. We were
too young to understand burnout and to not mock the word “depression”. But you still tried to
talk me through my sudden drops regardless.
They accused you of trying to set me up with boys. It wasn't uttered but it was clear, the subtext,
you were corrupting my feminine innocence. But I think of the times you stayed quiet and
listened in rage when I shared stories I wasn't ‘woman enough’ yet to understand were of
assault. When we both blushed and giggled talking about books and celebrities we discovered
on the internet. When we shared secrets in hushed tones about our blooming curiosity. Was that
so evil? An understanding of something so natural that comes in discussion and protection
instead of a sudden spear breaking through a long forgotten door to lay claim to the pristine
castle like a conquerer?
Remember when they used to call us “husband and wife”? When we were inseparable and
young. We laughed about it. Then we grew subconscious about it. Perhaps it was just little
minds not finding any way to look around the practiced heteronormative ending. The closest
bond- only between a wedded man & a woman. As if ‘best friend’ was in some way lacking in
term. As if friendships could never have their own forevers and therefore null.
Perhaps they too had the words hammered into their pliant soft clay souls. A little too early.
“Boro hole kothay ke chole jabe!”
Uttered with such conviction as if something that isn't with you until the end is useless. As if no
bond, along with a woman's feeble tie with her family, blood or chosen, was ever holding of any
significant importance.
But do I think that? Do I look at the memories in my Google photos, the ‘cringe’ videos of myself
that I can not get myself to delete just because I was being ‘cringe’ With You, and wish you were
never in my life? Do I reminisce childhood and trace over your face with an air of insignificance
or spite just because you never reached out either? Or because I have made friends who do
share my interests in genuine, who do not look at me with utter confusion and derision when I
share about my chronic sadness, that I think our time growing together had meant nothing?
Maybe we really were too different. Polar opposites can not stick too long before inevitably
repelling. Maybe we grew apart far far longer before our final goodbye. When hugs and punches
were replaced by polite smiles and awkward waves in the crowded pandal. Undiluted
confessions replaced small talk and “acha's”. Maybe it started when you took my racket and
spent the Tiffin period playing with the
cool kids
instead of teaching me like you promised.
Maybe it was when I let you sit quietly and then walk away to your section as I was too busy
yapping with the girl in my class about
wattpad
. But it didn't end with hatred or nonchalance. I
hope you know that in your heart even when I pull a low smile as I ask about your studies. I
hope it is true for you when you nod and say goodbye as you leave the event with your mother. I
hope you know people from the past still ask me about you just as they used to when you
skipped class all those years ago.
I wish I had those letters now. To know what unabashed confessions of gratitude and
vulnerability looks like. I wish I wrote more when I saw you slowly curl into yourself as the years
went by. You know, I used to think I was a big giant vampire who was slowly sucking the
vivacious life out of you as you helped me come out of my shell, and I watched as you crawled
into it. As silly as it sounds. I wish we were still as unabashed then so you could've told me why.
I wish I learned more about you before the treasure chest snapped up and sealed all its light
within again.
I hope I can remember though. And learn again how to tell you about the tears I shed over our
friendship fraying. Without feeling too carved open, to your face. I hope I can tell you one day,
without fear of coming off too clingy, that you were my favorite part of my drab childhood. That if
I ever found it in me to wish to return, it would've been for my wish to sit with you again, in the
same bench, talking to you about the same mundane secrets. And that I am glad I got to learn
and hurt and run and grow with you.
I know my excuses suck. Even I hear them! “Your gift got torn because my cousin pulled it.”,
“The teddy you gave got mauled by the neighbor's toddler”, “I couldn't reach out because dad
would've said something infuriating again", "I didn't click follow because I was still traumatized
from the last incident”. “
The insects fucking ate my letter
So if in some place, we did meet again, as carefree and naive as we used to be when our
friendship bloomed, I'd tell you-
I am sorry and I thank you. Thank you for growing up with me. Thank you for letting us be girls
together, despite the omens flying over us. And everyday I grow proud of the woman you
become. Even from afar.
But I remember what you would've told me when we were 11. Smack me and say “kuttar
baccha, friendship e no sorry no thankyou.”
So I'll just wait till one day I can suck it up and text you again, “
�তােক খুব
miss
কির �দাস্ত
Till then,
Your best friend,
even if the forever didn't stick.

went by. You know, I used to think I was a big giant vampire who was slowly sucking the
vivacious life out of you as you helped me come out of my shell, and I watched as you crawled
into it. As silly as it sounds. I wish we were still as unabashed then so you could've told me why.
I wish I learned more about you before the treasure chest snapped up and sealed all its light
within again.
I hope I can remember though. And learn again how to tell you about the tears I shed over our
friendship fraying. Without feeling too carved open, to your face. I hope I can tell you one day,
without fear of coming off too clingy, that you were my favorite part of my drab childhood. That if
I ever found it in me to wish to return, it would've been for my wish to sit with you again, in the
same bench, talking to you about the same mundane secrets. And that I am glad I got to learn
and hurt and run and grow with you.
I know my excuses suck. Even I hear them! “Your gift got torn because my cousin pulled it.”,
“The teddy you gave got mauled by the neighbor's toddler”, “I couldn't reach out because dad
would've said something infuriating again", "I didn't click follow because I was still traumatized
from the last incident”. “The insects fucking ate my letter.”
So if in some place, we did meet again, as carefree and naive as we used to be when our
friendship bloomed, I'd tell you-
I am sorry and I thank you. Thank you for growing up with me. Thank you for letting us be girls
together, despite the omens flying over us. And everyday I grow proud of the woman you
become. Even from afar.
But I remember what you would've told me when we were 11. Smack me and say “kuttar
baccha, friendship e no sorry no thankyou.”
So I'll just wait till one day I can suck it up and text you again, “�তােক খুব miss কির �দাস্ত”.
Till then,
Your best friend,
even if the forever didn't stick.

runs.text: Can there be classism with cats? I have a desi cat. My cousin has a Persian one. You can already guess which one gets more attention. My relative told me as I was showing them my cat that these cats don't belong in homes. The Persian ones look better when you hold them. But both are cats, both play the same, act the same, exist the same and behave the same after all they are the same animal. That was the day I realized humans have developed classism even with beings that can’t speak.

And  can someone genuinely call themselves an animal lover if their compassion has conditions? A person will claim to be a cat lover, maybe even brag how they have many cats at home but suddenly that one stray cat in their garage is a problem. They will cry and grieve for months if their cat dies but won't spare a moment to feed the hungry cat they walk by everyday. So, why does our empathy die when the same being we love is not ours? Why do the persian, british short hair or Ragdoll cats get more sympathy than locals?

Perhaps the answer lies in how deeply we have intertwined animal ownership with social status. For some, the appeal of a particular breed extends beyond companionship, it becomes a reflection of the image they wish to project. But since when do cats have social status? Human beings created social hierarchies to distinguish themselves from one another. The distinctions between upper, middle and lower classes have existed for generations. But cats know nothing of these divisions. They don't understand why the Persian cats are more expensive, why they get good homes or why they are more loved.

Throughout the time it has become less about loving and owning a cat and has become more about owning that social status. Certain cat breeds are more socially acceptable, aesthetically pleasing because they are more expensive, social media promotes them more, they look prestigious and people will know the owner is fancy by their pets. Some People don't want a cat, they want the admiration that comes with owning one forgetting that an animal's worth cannot be measured by how well it complements its owner's lifestyle. Perhaps compassion has developed its own beauty standard as we find it easier to sympathise with animals that are pleasant to look at, forgetting that suffering doesn’t become less painful when it has an unpleasant appearance.

A cat doesn't understand the meaning of classism yet humans created one for them. Made one less valuable because it does not show our social status. But it's not about cats or animals. It's about everything if we sit and think for a moment. It's about how people are so hungry for class that sometimes they impose themselves even upon beings that have no understanding of the divisions we've created.

Dogs face the same as someone who will praise you for having a golden  retriever, a German shepherd or a husky but will kick around a street dog. If you get close to a street animal then people will impose how dirty, unhygienic or bad they are and maybe sometimes it is the truth street animals can spread diseases and can be aggressive. But being cautious around an animal is different from treating it cruelly when all they crave for is a little kindness. And when they want that kindness or some food most people push them away or even hit them so, can we really portray their defensive reaction as aggression without knowing what circumstances they have been in? I am not saying every human does that or has bad intentions behind it. Sometimes you can just be allergic or sick to not go near them but what excuse do we others have?
Over time it has become more about the price tag on the animal not the emotional value of it. We started to seek social validation so much we never questioned what we inherited.
